local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Limpeza de UI anterior
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("BillionaireGodMode") then CoreGui.BillionaireGodMode:Destroy() end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", CoreGui)

-- Estado do Script
_G.GodMode = false

-- Interface Minimalista
local Main = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)

Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.1, 0)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
Main.Active = true
Main.Draggable = true -- Ativa arraste básico
Instance.new("UICorner", Main)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", Main)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Title.Text = "GOD MODE: MONEY"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Title.Font = "GothamBold"
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local ActionBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", Main)
ActionBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 45)
ActionBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.4, 0)
ActionBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 50)
ActionBtn.Text = "ATIVAR VELOCIDADE MÁXIMA"
ActionBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
ActionBtn.Font = "GothamBold"
Instance.new("UICorner", ActionBtn)

-- Lógica de Dinheiro Infinito (Fast-Loop)
ActionBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    _G.GodMode = not _G.GodMode
    
    if _G.GodMode then
        ActionBtn.Text = "RODANDO (1-500M/ms)"
        ActionBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
        
        task.spawn(function()
            local remote = RS:FindFirstChild("CratesUtilities") and RS.CratesUtilities:FindFirstChild("Remotes") and RS.CratesUtilities.Remotes:FindFirstChild("GiveReward")
            
            if not remote then 
                warn("Remote não encontrado! Verifique se o jogo mudou.")
                return 
            end

            while _G.GodMode do
                -- Dispara 50 vezes instantaneamente antes do próximo wait
                -- Isso simula o ganho por milissegundo
                for i = 1, 50 do
                    local randomAmount = tostring(math.random(1000000, 500000000))
                    remote:FireServer(randomAmount)
                end
                task.wait() -- Pausa mínima para o motor não travar (0.03s)
            end
        end)
    else
        ActionBtn.Text = "ATIVAR VELOCIDADE MÁXIMA"
        ActionBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 50)
    end
end)
